h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Pune

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Pune

items.pText: Pune has more schools, colleges and new housing projects than most cities its size, and a large share of our Maharashtra enquiries come from here. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai East, about 140 km away. We send it over the ghats by road and install it with our own team or a local dealer.

Buyers in Pune tend to arrive with a clear brief. An architect may have marked the play area on a master plan, or a school may have a fixed ground and an age group in mind. We work from that brief, suggest equipment and send a drawing with the safe play area for each piece, so you can check the fit before you approve a quote.

c: Designer, Manufacturer of Outdoor Play Equipment

Pune schools often run nursery, primary and middle sections on one campus, with short breaks when many children come out together. Spreading them across several pieces works better than one large tower. Swings, see-saws and a merry-go-round take groups at once, and a separate corner for the youngest keeps them away from running feet.
Schools looking for something less common can use our
panels, which turn a boundary wall or a corridor into a place for puzzles and games.

richText.heading: Gated communities in Baner, Wakad, Kharadi and Hadapsar

c: Most new projects in these areas plan a children's play area alongside the clubhouse and pool. Buyers notice it at the site visit, so builders want a piece that looks finished and stands up to daily use after possession.

wooden structures suit landscaped gardens where the architect wants natural materials. For a podium, a roto-moulded play station on a self-standing base is the simpler choice. Projects across the river in

Pune is milder than Mumbai for much of the year, with cool winter mornings and dry heat in April and May. The monsoon is steady from June to September and heavier towards the western edge of the city. Galvanised posts and roto-moulded parts handle both the dry heat and the wet months.

Black soil in parts of the city swells when wet and cracks in summer. On such ground we grout posts into a proper concrete base so they stay level. Where the ground is rocky, we decide the method after seeing photos.

Share the CAD plan or a marked site layout and we will place the equipment on it with the safe play area shown. That helps your garden consultant plan paving, planting and drainage around the playground at the same stage.

items.q: Do you deliver and install playground equipment in Pune?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture at our factory in Vasai East, about 140 km from Pune, send the equipment by road and install it with our own team or a local dealer. Tell us about the site gate and access road so we can plan the delivery.

items.q: Can you work from our architect's drawings?
items.a: Yes. Send the plan with the play area marked and the age groups you expect. We place the equipment on the drawing, show the safe play area for each piece and share a quote for your review.

items.q: Which equipment suits a school with many children at break time?
items.a: Pieces that take several children at once, such as multi-seat swings, see-saws and merry-go-rounds, spread across the ground. A separate zone for nursery children keeps them apart from older pupils. We can show this on a layout.

items.q: Do you offer wooden playground equipment?
items.a: Yes. Our NexLev Woody range uses wood, and some of our other ranges use wooden and composite parts. Wooden structures suit landscaped gardens. Ask us about the care they need in Pune's monsoon before you choose.
